title: Feature Pipelines and Stores: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Feature Pipelines and Stores: Visual Guide

1. Events To Inputs | the five pipeline stages from ingestion to materialization, each with its input, output and contract | events are immutable so everything downstream is recomputable, and aggregation is the one stateful stage where the correctness risk lives

2. The Sliding Window | user_ctr_7d recomputed as the as-of date is dragged across a timeline of impressions and clicks, plus an overwrite-versus-append toggle | a feature is entity, value and as-of timestamp, and a run must own and overwrite its output partition or the first retry doubles every count

3. Which Clock | five events with late arrivals bucketed by processing time and by event time, with a re-run button | windowing on processing time makes a re-run assign events to different windows, while event time plus a declared lateness horizon is stable by construction

4. Two Projections | the offline columnar store and the online key-value store judged against a training scan and a serving point read | the two stores are two projections of one computation, and each layout fails badly at the other's job

5. When The Run Is Missed | four null-handling policies for an expired online read, with the feature vector each one sends to the model | the serving code's default policy is a model input, so defaulting to zero tells the model a long-standing customer is brand new
